Install Northwind Agent

Northwind Agent reads now-playing data from Acme Playout and reports each play.

1. Download

Download northwind-agent-win.zip

2. Extract and configure

Extract the archive to C:\northwind-agent\ and copy config.example.json to config.json. Add your API key.

3. Install the service

Run install-northwind-service.bat and allow it to make changes.
